description: Look at what’s in front of you and stop creating a fake future. #selflove #selfimprovement #intentionalliving
transcript: The outcome will never be what you expect it to be, and that is what keeps me living in reality. I do not create a fake future. Don't expect any person place or thing to react the way in which I'd want them to react. I observe and allow things to form on its own, and at that point, I readjust accordingly, but I don't ever expect anything to be what I want it to be.
